crossRefs.note: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing…
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ…
he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.

that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord…

who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace…
but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you…

translations.web: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
translations.bsb: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
translations.kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
translations.asv: to the end that ye should walk worthily of God, who calleth you into his own kingdom and glory.
